title: Deep Q-Networks (DQN): Deep Reinforcement Learning: Part 2 - The Bellman Loss Equation: Approximating High-Dimensional Action-Value Functions

beats.text: Why is Deep Q-Networks (DQN) a major breakthrough? Because this breakthrough introduces the first deep learning model to successfully learn control policies directly from high-dimensional sensory input using reinforcement learning.
beats.visual_focus: System architecture schematic introducing Deep Q-Networks (DQN).

beats.text: The core challenge? The model is a convolutional neural network, trained with a variant of Q-learning, whose input is raw pixels and whose output is a value function estimating future rewards.
beats.visual_focus: Bottleneck diagram illustrating resource contention and latency walls.

beats.text: Enter Deep Q-Networks (DQN): we apply our method to seven Atari 2600 games from the Arcade Learning Environment, with no adjustment of the architecture or learning algorithm.
beats.visual_focus: Split-screen contrasting traditional approaches with Deep Q-Networks (DQN).
